marketing_description: The Speed Queen® Professional Series DR7004BG sanitizing gas dryer offers a 7 cu‑ft galvanized‑steel drum and 710 rpm rotation to efficiently dry commercial loads, while its 22 000 Btu/hr gas heater and 1/3 hp motor deliver consistent performance. Integrated features such as Anti‑Static, Commercial Cool‑Down Technology, Extended Tumble, Lint Filter Guard, Moisture Sensor, Pet Plus, and multiple steam options—including Steam Boost, Refresh, and Sanitize—provide versatile cycle control, and the unit’s 220 cfm exhaust airflow with a 4‑in. outlet fits standard shop installations. Dimensions are 43 in H × 26‑7/8 in W × 28 in D, with a door opening depth of 51‑½ in and a 38‑¼ in lid opening height, and it operates on 120 V.
